name: bent-tube
why: A real bend, against a closed form: pi*25*70 + pi*15*25*(pi/2) = 7348.34 mm3 for 70 mm of trimmed run and a quarter turn of radius 15. The mesh reads 0.12% under it — the tessellation under-reading curved surfaces. The tangent trimming is what the number checks: a bend placed without shortening the runs reads high, and the five faces are what says the runs and the arc fused into one chain rather than three overlapping lumps.
